notes.title: Longer battles and better battles!
notes.content:
[list]
[*] Altered Druid starting deck
[*] Rebalanced Lich entirely (almost like new?)
[*] Changed Bosses behaviour and power
[*] Increased length of all encounters substantially
[*] Adjusted some game breaking cards to make them more playable Time Step, Grave Shock, Rapier of Neem
[/list]

notes.title: Patch v1.74
notes.content:
- Souls reworded
- Earthbound fixed
- End Turn Button sizing fixed
- Fusion cards can be black bordered or half half.
- Multi touch gestures ignored, card positions should be better.
- Traditional Chinese language fixed 正體字/繁體字

notes.title: Update v1.73
notes.content:
- Fixed card positions when drawn into hand sometimes not in order
- Fixed several wording issues

notes.title: Update v1.70
notes.content:
- Improved interface and controls including mouse over events
- Fixed Poison Bite on enemies not being used
- Smoother animations and effects
- Improved card descriptions and tutorial prompts
- Accidental discards fixed

- 提高了用户界面以及鼠标控制的问题
- 修复“毒性撕咬“的bug
- 提高了动画以及视觉效果的流畅程度
- 优化了卡牌的表述已经新手教程的提示

notes.title: Update v1.63
notes.content:
- New audio for events, skills and encounters
- Fixed No Shadow Strike freezing
- Several card fixes, Apocalypse, Amplify Poison, Poison Dagger, Six Paths of Pain, Beast Form
- Monk Gates should now operate correctly
- Enemy not playing cards bug fixed

notes.title: Monk Class Update!
notes.content:
Deck builders have been chomping at the bit for this for some time!

The Monk class is the 10th included class in the game and brings a whole new way to play including the secret 3rd, 5th and 8th Gates which are unlocked as you progress!

Now go smash the Lich one more time!
